mapper.select: SELECT resume_my_id , user_id , resume_id , title , status , memo , created_at , updated_at , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_str , is_deleted FROM resume_my WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, resume_my_id DESC

SELECT resume_my_id , user_id , resume_id , title , status , memo , created_at , updated_at , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_str , is_deleted FROM resume_my WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY (status = 'COMPLETE') DESC , updated_at DESC , resume_my_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cover_letter_idx , user_id , title , company_name , save_status AS status , created_at , DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str FROM cover_letter WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM JOB_SCRAP js INNER JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = js.job_id INNER JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id WHERE js.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND jp.close_date < CURDATE()
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja WHERE ja.user_id = js.user_id AND ja.job_id = js.job_id )

SELECT p.pay_id, p.user_id, p.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_date, '%y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS pay_date_text, p.pay_price, p.pay_status, p.pay_method, pr.product_name FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY p.pay_date DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.safeSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
